columns.name: having_IP_Address
columns.description: Indicates whether the URL uses an IP address instead of a domain name, often used by phishers to hide their identity.

columns.name: URL_Length
columns.description: Measures the character length of the URL; phishers often use long URLs to hide the suspicious domain.

columns.name: Shortining_Service
columns.description: Indicates whether a URL shortening service (like bit.ly) is used to redirect and hide the true malicious URL.

columns.name: having_At_Symbol
columns.description: Indicates whether the URL contains an '@' symbol, which causes the browser to ignore everything preceding it.

columns.name: double_slash_redirecting
columns.description: Indicates whether a double slash '//' appears after the initial protocol, a technique used for hidden redirection.

columns.name: Prefix_Suffix
columns.description: Indicates whether the domain name includes a hyphen '-', a common technique to make a fake URL look like a legitimate one.

columns.name: having_Sub_Domain
columns.description: Evaluates the number of subdomains in the URL; phishing sites often use multiple subdomains to appear legitimate.

columns.name: SSLfinal_State
columns.description: Evaluates the HTTPS and SSL certificate's validity, issuer trustworthiness, and age.

columns.name: Domain_registeration_length
columns.description: Measures how long the domain has been registered; phishing sites typically have very short registration lifespans.

columns.name: Favicon
columns.description: Indicates whether the website's favicon image is loaded from a domain different from the main URL.

columns.name: port
columns.description: Indicates whether non-standard network ports are open, which is often a sign of a compromised or malicious server.

columns.name: HTTPS_token
columns.description: Indicates whether the string 'https' is deceptively included within the domain part of the URL.

columns.name: Request_URL
columns.description: Measures the percentage of external objects (like images or videos) loaded from a different domain.

columns.name: URL_of_Anchor
columns.description: Evaluates whether anchor tags link to different domains, do not link to any webpage, or link to the same webpage.

columns.name: Links_in_tags
columns.description: Examines the percentage of links within metadata, script, and link HTML tags pointing to external domains.

columns.name: SFH
columns.description: Server Form Handler; evaluates if webpage form actions are handled suspiciously (e.g., routed to 'about:blank' or a different domain).

columns.name: Submitting_to_email
columns.description: Checks if the website forms submit data directly to an email address (mailto:) instead of a secure server.

columns.name: Abnormal_URL
columns.description: Identifies if the host name is not included in the URL based on WHOIS database records.

columns.name: Redirect
columns.description: Indicates if the website uses excessive or hidden redirection to route users away from their intended destination.

columns.name: on_mouseover
columns.description: Checks if JavaScript is used to alter the status bar to hide the true link destination when a user hovers over it.

columns.name: RightClick
columns.description: Indicates if right-clicking is disabled on the page, a tactic used to prevent users from viewing the page source code.

columns.name: popUpWidnow
columns.description: Checks if the website generates pop-up windows, especially those containing text fields asking for personal information.

columns.name: Iframe
columns.description: Indicates if invisible or borderless iframes are used to load external, potentially malicious content without the user noticing.

columns.name: age_of_domain
columns.description: The age of the domain; older domains are usually more trustworthy, whereas phishing domains are recently registered.

columns.name: DNSRecord
columns.description: Checks if the domain has a valid DNS record; phishing domains often lack these or are missing from WHOIS databases.

columns.name: web_traffic
columns.description: Evaluates the website's popularity and traffic rank (e.g., Alexa rank); phishing sites usually have low or unrecognized traffic.

columns.name: Page_Rank
columns.description: Evaluates the importance of the webpage based on its PageRank value; lower scores are highly suspicious.

columns.name: Google_Index
columns.description: Checks whether the website is currently indexed by Google; phishing sites are often not indexed.

columns.name: Links_pointing_to_page
columns.description: Evaluates how many external links point to the webpage; legitimate sites usually have many incoming links.

columns.name: Statistical_report
columns.description: Checks if the website's IP or domain is currently present in recognized phishing statistical reports or blacklists.

columns.name: label
columns.description: The target classification label; indicates whether the website is legitimate or a phishing site.
